lantern: Design an offline 3D exhibit for a science museum: a faceted six-sided lantern. Deliver index.html and lantern.obj. In the OBJ use three separate named objects base, glass and cap, stacked along the Y axis in that order. Give each a closed triangulated surface, nonzero volume and no missing faces. Make the glass taller than the base and cap combined. In the browser show the same model on a turntable, with a ground reference, contrasting materials, drag-to-orbit, labelled Pause and Reset controls, and a useful initial view on a 360px phone. Reset must restore the original angle. Use no CDN or remote assets. Include a short README explaining how to preview and import the mesh.
returns: Build a SQLite ledger for a shop that accepts partial returns. Deliver ledger.sql; it should run on a fresh SQLite database. Use sales(receipt TEXT, qty INTEGER, unit_paise INTEGER) and returns(event_id TEXT, receipt TEXT, qty INTEGER). Reject unknown receipts, nonpositive quantities, and cumulative returns greater than the original sale. A repeated event ID with identical values must be a harmless no-op, even after the entire sale has been returned. Expose refunds(receipt, refunded_paise) with one row per sale, including sales with no returns. Use integer arithmetic, and document the replay behavior in a short README.
